page.overview:
Who is Sir Toby Belch?

Sir Toby Belch is a major character in William Shakespeare's Twelfth Night . He is a drunkard that enjoys having fun at the expense of others, friend and foe alike. He is highly clever even in his drunken state and can manipulate others to get his morbid entertainment.

Sir Toby Belch is Olivia's uncle. He enjoys parties and drinking. He is easily entertained and takes great joy in the misery of others. He lives in Illyria, where the story of Twelfth Night takes place.
